name: Freezing Fog (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School conjuration (creation) [cold]; Level bloodlord 6, druid 6, magus 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, unchained summoner 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect fog spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Freezing fog creates a billowing mass of freezing vapors like the solid fog spell. Additionally, this spell’s vapors are freezing cold.

Each round on your turn, starting when you cast the spell, the fog deals 2d6 points of cold damage to each creature and object within it.
